title: Global Validation Surface Split
goal: Break the monolithic validation invocation into deterministic stage surfaces and thin wrapper entrypoints so narrower subtask runs finish faster without changing validation semantics.

problem_statement.current_state: scripts/global_validate.py can execute multiple validation stages, but callers still have to invoke the broad surface and reconstruct stage subsets themselves.
problem_statement.gap: There is no canonical surface helper or named wrapper entrypoints for the common validation subsets.
problem_statement.risk: Wide invocations keep the context surface large, make focused validation harder to remember, and encourage redundant stage selection logic.

basis.scope: Add deterministic stage slicing and thin surface wrappers without changing validation semantics or governance authority.

required_repo_changes.description: Add stage selection flags and named stage listing so the validator can run a bounded subset of its plan.
Add a thin helper that forwards fixed stage subsets and optional mode flags to the canonical validator.
Expose the registry-oriented validation surface as a thin wrapper.
Expose the governance-oriented validation surface as a thin wrapper.
Expose the database-oriented validation surface as a thin wrapper.
Expose the math-oriented validation surface as a thin wrapper.
Expose the operational validation surface as a thin wrapper.
Document the stage slicing and wrapper entrypoints for governed validation.
Synchronize the textbook governance note with the validation surface split.

acceptance_criteria: python -m scripts.global_validate --list-stages prints the selected stage names for the active mode.
Each surface wrapper runs only its fixed stage subset under the correct mode flag.
Registry, governance, db, math, and operational surfaces run without independent state reconstruction.
Documentation and textbook references note the surface split.
Hash registry and ledger records are updated.

warnings: Stage slicing is additive and does not change validation semantics.
The wrapper scripts are compatibility surfaces, not new governance authorities.
